# lakebase-payer-search

> Typo-tolerant name search (fuzzy search, typeahead, autocomplete) served as one REST endpoint by the Databricks Lakebase Data API (PostgREST-style RPC), with service-principal OAuth and no database connection in the client. Plain Postgres inside: pg_trgm for typos, lakebase_text BM25 for words and synonyms. The example corpus is US health insurers (payers), synthetic IDs; reuse it for any closed list of names.

Facts an agent should not get wrong:
- Endpoint: `POST <DATA_API_BASE>/api/rpc/search_insurers`, body `{"q", "customer_id", "lim", "off"}`. 10 per page, 50 results max. Bad input returns HTTP 400.
- Auth: Databricks OAuth M2M token for a service principal (`/oidc/v1/token`, `client_credentials`). Not a Postgres password. The built-in connection pooler is not used.
- The caller's Postgres role can EXECUTE one function and read zero tables (`SECURITY DEFINER` function owned by a `NOLOGIN` role).
- Deploy = `databricks bundle deploy` (project + compute, 2–16 CU) then `scripts/setup.sh` (steps 0–7). Step 0 turns on Lakebase Search for the project via `POST /api/2.0/postgres/projects/<id>/search-extensions`; it restarts the compute once and cannot be undone.
- Measured on AWS, 3M synthetic alias rows: 9.8 ms p50 inside Postgres; 315–331 requests/s at 2–16 CU; right brand in the top 10 for 98.4% of 899 test queries. Not measured on Azure (same API).

- [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md): glossary of the words used in this repo
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to build, test and change this repo as a coding agent

## Code
- [sql/10_search_index.sql](sql/10_search_index.sql): synonyms (replace vs expand), search keys, GiST trigram + BM25 indexes, word list, search log
- [sql/20_search_function.sql](sql/20_search_function.sql): `api.search_insurers` -> `search_idx.search_core`: input checks, "did you mean", candidates, scoring, paging, log
- [sql/40_caller_grants.sql](sql/40_caller_grants.sql): the caller gets EXECUTE on one function, nothing else
- [src/insurer_search/client.py](src/insurer_search/client.py): reference client: token cache, retry 429/5xx, one refresh on 401, no retry on 400/403, 5 s timeout
- [databricks.yml](databricks.yml): bundle: Lakebase project and read-write compute
- [scripts/setup.sh](scripts/setup.sh): idempotent setup, steps 0–7
- [scripts/ci_proof.sh](scripts/ci_proof.sh): build everything on a new project, run all tests, delete it all
- [postman/](postman/): token, search, paging, typos, errors, security checks

## Evidence
- [results/exact-name-deepdive-2026-10-06.md](results/exact-name-deepdive-2026-10-06.md): exact-name sweep (0 misses of 6,291 payers), v2 load test at 2–16 CU
- [results/quality-fn-v2-synfix.json](results/quality-fn-v2-synfix.json): evaluator, 899 queries by kind
- [results/wider-word-2026-10-07.md](results/wider-word-2026-10-07.md): wider-word queries, 80 of 88 in the top 10, and the 8 misses
- [results/loadtest-cu32-2026-10-06.md](results/loadtest-cu32-2026-10-06.md): 16–32 CU load test; 1 CU ran out of memory (HTTP 500)
- [results/coldstart-2026-10-06.md](results/coldstart-2026-10-06.md): first call after scale-to-zero about 1.6 s, HTTP 200
- [results/zero-downtime-2026-10-06.md](results/zero-downtime-2026-10-06.md): 7,486 of 7,486 searches succeeded during a full resync + index refresh
